title: RecallResponseV1
description: Response body for recall.request.v1 (K0→K1). Carries the recalled hits plus aggregate latency/truncation flags. Returned synchronously on the same HTTP request — never published independently.

hits.description: Recalled atoms, ordered by relevance/recency depending on selector mix.

total.description: Total matching atoms across selectors (may exceed len(hits) when truncated).

latency_ms.description: K0-side wall-clock latency for the aggregate query.

truncated.description: True when fail_fast or max_results truncated the bundle.

atom_id.description: Stable identifier of the recalled atom.

content.description: Atom content (shape depends on the selector type).

source.description: K0 storage layer / selector that produced this hit (e.g. wal, pgvector, kg).

selector_type.description: Optional selector kind that produced this hit.

cursor.description: Optional continuation cursor for fetching more from this point.
